description: As Elixir's CLI (cli.ex:134-183): a bottom handler written in fz formats the uncaught banner via Exception.message, computed only when uncaught; failure_line's exception branch leaves Rust. Earlier cost proxy: hello-world products 401 -> 876, protocol_dispatch facts 2 -> 18 (dispatch on any pulls every impl). Re-measure first; own proposal page.
title: The uncaught banner is rendered through Exception.message by an fz handler at the bottom of every process
